# Map request: the islet at the Mothers' Mound (owner decision K64)

**For:** the lead, for the coming map import (4.5.0).
**Basis:** K64 (25 October 2026): "The map gains one islet at the Mothers' Mound." Addendum `k62_fallen_realms.md` 6.3, "Map additions": a one-province rock at the Mothers' Mound west of Aenor Isle, an islet that no realm owns at the start.
**Why this is a request and not an edit:** the geography model (`tools/content/data/geography/aoaz.json`, generated by `tools/content/geography/*.mjs` from the owner-approved layout of 17 and 18 October 2026 recorded in `docs/generation/assumptions.md`) has no declared place for owner-approved additions: its `lands` come from the reference silhouettes, `layout_overrides.json` is regenerated from the drawing, and `namedProposed` holds names only. The map files are not edited by the deep-past task.

## The feature

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Name | The Mothers' Mound (working label; the top of the drowned city's greatest moot-mound, which breaks the water at the lowest spring tides) |
| Kind | land, one province, a bare rock islet (terrain: hills or rocky coast; no river; elevation class 1) |
| Place | in the Crown Sea (the model's `sea_crown_ocean`), west of Aenor Isle: Aenor Isle's bbox in the model is x 0.5117 to 0.5352, y 0.5578 to 0.5781 (game layout frame, 5120 x 2560); the islet's centre at about **x 0.497, y 0.567** (pixel about 2545, 1452), some 75 to 90 pixels west of the isle's west end and clear of every land polygon of the model (checked: no land contains the points 0.490 to 0.500, 0.566 to 0.568) |
| Size | the smallest province the import allows (a single province of about 6 to 10 pixels across); it must not touch Aenor Isle, so the Mound is reached only by sea |
| Sea | inside the same sea strategic region as the waters west of Aenor Isle; the Nimlan banks (the shoals over the drowned fields) lie around it |
| State | its own one-province state named **The Mothers' Mound** (so the key-sites rule `state_name` resolves it), category wasteland or the smallest category, no building slots, no victory point, no resources, no manpower worth recording |
| Owner at the start | K64 and the addendum say no realm owns it. HOI4 needs every land state to have an owner, so the request is: **Orohaf** owns and cores it at the start (the isle houses' divers are the only people who go there); if the import can leave a state unowned, leave it so and the site rule falls back to Orohaf's coast |
| Ports | one naval base slot allowed (the dive needs a harbour of level 2 at the shore facing the Mound; today that is Orohaf's seat) |
| Adjacency | none to land; no strait crossing |
| Name in the model | add "The Mothers' Mound" to `namedProposed` until the import places it, then to the established names |

## What changes in the scripts when it exists

`modules/deep_past.mjs` resolves the site `mothers_mound_shore` as Orohaf's capital today (`SITE_ROWS`, note on the row). When the islet exists, the row becomes `state_name` The Mothers' Mound, the dive's harbour requirement reads that state, and the dive's reach becomes "owns the Mound, or holds Orohaf's Tide". Nothing else changes; no script names a state number.

## A second, smaller request

The site `kalioth_halls` (Barzoth on the Kalioth upland) resolves to Erco's capital until a state is named for the upland. If the import names Erco's upland state **Kalioth**, the row becomes `state_name` Kalioth.
